```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.ticker import PercentFormatter

df = pd.read_csv("BRFSS_2025_NC_Final_Analysis.csv")

df = df.loc[
    df["Diabetes_Binary"].isin([0, 1])
    & np.isfinite(df["Survey_Weight"])
    & (df["Survey_Weight"] > 0)
].copy()

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.size": 11,
    "figure.dpi": 120
})

BLUE = "#3274A1"
ORANGE = "#E18B46"

bmi_order = ["Normal", "Overweight", "Obesity I", "Obesity II+"]

df["BMI_Category"] = pd.cut(
    df["BMI"],
    bins=[18.5, 25, 30, 35, np.inf],
    labels=bmi_order,
    right=False
)

df["Smoking_Group"] = df["Smoking_Status"].replace({
    "Current daily": "Current",
    "Current some days": "Current"
})


def weighted_prevalence(data, column, categories):
    """Weighted percentage with diabetes within each category."""
    results = []

    for category in categories:
        group = data.loc[data[column] == category]

        if group.empty:
            results.append(np.nan)
        else:
            results.append(
                100 * np.average(
                    group["Diabetes_Binary"],
                    weights=group["Survey_Weight"]
                )
            )

    return np.array(results)


def prevalence_barplot(ax, categories, values, title, xlabel):
    ax.bar(categories, values, color=BLUE, width=0.65)

    for position, value in enumerate(values):
        if np.isfinite(value):
            ax.annotate(
                f"{value:.1f}%",
                xy=(position, value),
                xytext=(0, 5),
                textcoords="offset points",
                ha="center"
            )

    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_xlabel(xlabel)
    ax.set_ylabel("Diagnosed diabetes prevalence (%)")
    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(xmax=100))
    ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
    ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.2)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)


def finish_figure(fig):
    fig.tight_layout
    plt.show()
```

# Figure 1: Diabetes prevalence across BMI categories
How does diagnosed diabetes prevalence vary across BMI categories?

```{python}

bmi_prevalence = weighted_prevalence(
    df, "BMI_Category", bmi_order
)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))

prevalence_barplot(
    ax,
    bmi_order,
    bmi_prevalence,
    "Figure 1. Diabetes prevalence across BMI categories",
    "BMI category"
)

ax.set_ylim(0, max(5, np.nanmax(bmi_prevalence) * 1.25))

finish_figure(fig)
```

# Figure 2: Diabetes prevalence by activity and smoking
How do diabetes prevalence patterns vary by physical activity and smoking status?

```{python}
activity_order = ["Yes", "No"]
smoking_order = ["Never", "Former", "Current"]

activity_prevalence = weighted_prevalence(
    df, "Physical_Activity", activity_order
)

smoking_prevalence = weighted_prevalence(
    df, "Smoking_Group", smoking_order
)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(
    1, 2,
    figsize=(11, 5),
    sharey=True
)

prevalence_barplot(
    axes[0],
    activity_order,
    activity_prevalence,
    "A. Physical activity",
    "Physical activity"
)

prevalence_barplot(
    axes[1],
    smoking_order,
    smoking_prevalence,
    "B. Smoking status",
    "Smoking status"
)

maximum = np.nanmax(
    np.concatenate([activity_prevalence, smoking_prevalence])
)
axes[0].set_ylim(0, max(5, maximum * 1.25))

fig.suptitle(
    "Figure 2. Diabetes prevalence by physical activity and smoking"
)

finish_figure(fig)
```

# Figure 3: Consumption distributions by diabetes status
Do reported fruit and vegetable consumption distributions differ by diabetes status?

```{python}
def weighted_box_statistics(data, column, label):
    """Calculate weighted quartiles and 1.5-IQR whiskers."""
    group = (
        data[[column, "Survey_Weight"]]
        .dropna()
        .sort_values(column)
    )

    if group.empty:
        raise ValueError(f"No valid observations for {column}: {label}")

    values = group[column].to_numpy()
    weights = group["Survey_Weight"].to_numpy()

    # Cumulative proportion of total survey weight
    cumulative_weight = np.cumsum(weights) / weights.sum()

    # Weighted 25th, 50th, and 75th percentiles
    positions = np.searchsorted(
        cumulative_weight,
        [0.25, 0.50, 0.75]
    )
    q1, median, q3 = values[positions]

    iqr = q3 - q1

    lower_whisker = values[values >= q1 - 1.5 * iqr].min()
    upper_whisker = values[values <= q3 + 1.5 * iqr].max()

    outliers = values[
        (values < lower_whisker) | (values > upper_whisker)
    ]

    return {
        "label": label,
        "q1": q1,
        "med": median,
        "q3": q3,
        "whislo": lower_whisker,
        "whishi": upper_whisker,
        "fliers": outliers
    }


fig, axes = plt.subplots(
    1, 2,
    figsize=(11, 5),
    sharey=True
)

columns = ["Fruit_Times_Per_Day", "Vegetable_Times_Per_Day"]
titles = ["A. Fruit consumption", "B. Vegetable consumption"]

for ax, column, title in zip(axes, columns, titles):
    statistics = [
        weighted_box_statistics(
            df.loc[df["Diabetes_Binary"] == 0],
            column,
            "Without diabetes"
        ),
        weighted_box_statistics(
            df.loc[df["Diabetes_Binary"] == 1],
            column,
            "With diabetes"
        )
    ]

    boxes = ax.bxp(
        statistics,
        patch_artist=True,
        widths=0.5,
        medianprops={"color": "black"},
        flierprops={
            "marker": "o",
            "markersize": 3,
            "alpha": 0.3
        }
    )

    for box, color in zip(boxes["boxes"], [BLUE, ORANGE]):
        box.set_facecolor(color)
        box.set_alpha(0.75)

    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_xlabel("Diagnosed diabetes status")
    ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
    ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
    ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.2)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)

axes[0].set_ylabel("Reported consumption frequency (times/day)")

fig.suptitle(
    "Figure 3. Fruit and vegetable consumption by diabetes status"
)

finish_figure(fig)
```
